snippet.title: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty Complete Edition - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Visit the website: https://teamninja-studio.com/wolong/uk/ce/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=NS2AnnounceUKEU&utm_id=Caption

Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty Complete Edition, the dark Three Kingdoms action RPG, is coming to Nintendo Switch™ 2 on 3rd September 2026!

The Complete Edition includes the base game, the three DLC packs: "Battle of Zhongyuan", "Conqueror of Jiangdong", and "Upheaval in Jingxiang", and all additional content including collaboration DLCs with NARAKA: BLADEPOINT, Lies of P, and Nioh 2.
